sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United travel to Stafford Town on Saturday 28 November, looking to extend their excellent recent form. The visitors sit top of the table with 37 points from 17 games and have won their last two league matches, though they did suffer defeats in games three and four of their recent sequence. Stafford, currently fourth with 32 points, will provide a stern test on home turf.
divisionWide: Tuesday evening sees Alsager Town host Barnton in a mid-table encounter, with both sides looking to climb the standings. Saturday's remaining fixtures feature a cluster of contests across the division: Allscott Heath (7th, in strong form with three consecutive wins) welcome Crewe, while fifth-placed Eccleshall travel to Barnton. Brereton Social host struggling Alsager Town; Cheadle Heath Nomads entertain AFC Bridgnorth (3rd, unbeaten in their last three); Foley Meir face New Mills; Telford Town visit Widnes Town (the bottom two sides); Wednesfield Community host Shawbury United; and second-placed Wolverhampton Casuals (on a remarkable six-game winning streak in the league) travel to Dawley Town. The standout contest involves Wolverhampton Casuals' bid to maintain their perfect recent record against a Dawley side that has shown resilience with four wins in their last six.
